prompt:
Generate a photorealistic view of the same adult person shown in
the reference image(s).

Preserve the person's identity and preserve the hairstyle as closely
as possible.

Preserve:
- hair length
- haircut structure
- hair texture
- hair color
- hair volume
- hair density
- overall hairstyle

Only change the camera viewpoint.

Do not redesign, shorten, lengthen, recolor, straighten, curl,
or otherwise modify the hairstyle.

Natural photographic appearance.
Realistic individual hair strands.
Natural lighting.
No text.
No labels.
No annotations.
No collage.
No multiple people.


Target camera viewpoint:
Left rear three-quarter view, approximately 135 degrees from frontal. The subject is facing substantially away from the camera. The back of the head and hairstyle dominate the image. Only a small portion of the left side of the face may be visible at the edge. The nose should not be prominently visible. The mouth should not be clearly visible. The front facial features should be mostly occluded. The hairstyle should be viewed primarily from the rear-left direction. Head, neck, and shoulders are aligned and face away from the camera. Do not turn the head toward the camera..

The target should appear as though the camera has moved around
the same person while the person and hairstyle remain unchanged.

The relationship between the hair and the head must remain
anatomically plausible for this viewpoint.
